evidence.description: Direct access to a global singleton service via .shared

candidates.explanation: The component directly accesses the `EcosiaBrowserWindowAuthManager.shared` singleton instance to dispatch state changes, creating an implicit dependency that is difficult to isolate or substitute during testing.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: Write to isLoggedIn in helper method

candidates.explanation: The `isLoggedIn` property is a mutable instance state that is accessed and modified from multiple concurrency contexts (e.g., via `login`, `logout`, `retrieveStoredCredentials`, and `setupTokensWithCredentials` all involving `Task` blocks or `async` calls) without any visible actor isolation or synchronization boundary.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: Unstructured Task in init starting work that updates shared state
Path starting newer work (retrieveStoredCredentials) that updates same results

candidates.explanation: The initializer starts an unstructured `Task` to retrieve credentials. If `login()` or `retrieveStoredCredentials()` are called multiple times, newer work can start before older work completes, updating the same state properties without any cancellation or stale-result guard.
candidates.title: Replaceable Task Without Lifecycle Management
